description: San Francisco police incident reports from the city open data portal (data.sf.gov, dataset wg3w-h783): date and time, category, subcategory, description, resolution and police district. Newest reports first; reports as filed, not verified outcomes. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_canada_open_data when you need Canadian federal open datasets from open.canada.ca: title; gov_dati_gov_it_italy_open_data when you need Italian open government datasets from dati.gov.it: title. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Optional incident category, exact text, e.g. Lost Property
